summary: Frontend-only end-to-end retest of the new Roadmap feature (global Kanban + per-module embedded roadmap). Cleared localStorage, verified seed of 32 items across 16 modules and exercised every flow listed in the review request. All 30 assertions passed.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs benign console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Not blocking but noisy — consider adding minHeight/minWidth on chart containers. Pre-existing, not introduced by Roadmap feature.

critical_code_review_comments: Roadmap.jsx is ~310 lines and Roadmap dialog ~220 lines — fine for now but if more filters/views are added, extract KanbanColumn and ModuleCoverage into separate components.
Persisted store partialize correctly excludes transient UI state; version=2 set on persist — good.
RoadmapItemDialog `tags` field accepts string or array; submit normalises — safe, but could lint stricter PropTypes/TS to avoid mixed types in state.
Roadmap reset uses native window.confirm — works for tests but consider shadcn AlertDialog for UX consistency.
Kanban card uses motion.button with nested buttons (Move chips use role=button on spans to avoid invalid nested <button>) — good handling.
No data-testid hygiene issues found; all required testids present and used.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage before run, which triggered the seedRoadmapIfEmpty hydration of the 32 ROADMAP_SEED items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Roadmap feature fully verified: nav-roadmap+NEW badge, KPIs (total=32, modules=16), 4 Kanban columns, 32 cards, filters (module/priority), edit dialog (prefill+save), kanban-add-{status}, hover Move chips moving cards across columns with correct counts, reset-to-seed, persistence across reload, 4 representative module pages (maturity/observability/incidents/delivery-kit) each with 2 seed items and Add button, adding from /maturity prefills moduleId='maturity' and the new item also appears on the global board, status cycle works (in_progress -> done observed), edit pencil opens dialog, delete button in edit dialog removes the item. Brand credit shows 'CRAFTED BY · Siddharth Dutt'. Only pre-existing Recharts width(-1) warning observed — not Roadmap-related.
